name: Sight
overview: Scripture reveals that sight is both a physical gift from God and a spiritual blessing that He opens in the hearts of people. The Lord is described as one who opens the eyes of the blind and raises those who are bowed down, demonstrating His power to heal and restore (Psalms 146:8; Luke 4:18). Sight symbolizes understanding and faith, as God created both the seeing eye and hearing ear (Proverbs 20:12), and He opens spiritual eyes to turn individuals from darkness to light, enabling forgiveness and sanctification through faith in Christ (Acts 26:18). True faith involves confidence in what is not seen, highlighting that spiritual sight transcends physical vision (Hebrews 11:1).
